selection: Per run: minimum original sentence dev loss over five fixed same-length donor maps; earliest tie. Readouts evaluated on the same selected checkpoint.
comparison: Within each dataset hold architecture, positional mode, optimizer, examples, initialization, order, donors and dropout schedule fixed between objectives.
readout_metric: Per-pair utterance-level matched-vs-same-length-negative AUC; report all three pairs and seeds, five donor maps are not independent training seeds.
configuration_selection: Use this objective/readout comparison to characterize candidates; final dataset configuration requires paired downstream dev-MAE comparison at fixed budget. No test-based selection.
scope: Pretraining/readout factorial comparison; no new downstream training in this stage
